navigation_followup_executed_source: await (async (page) => { const captures=[]; for (const viewport of [{width:1280,height:720},{width:390,height:844}]) { await page.setViewportSize(viewport); await page.getByRole("link",{name:"鸟瞰地图",exact:true}).waitFor({state:"visible"}); const path="output/playwright/atlas-services-satellite-"+viewport.width+".png"; const state=await page.getByRole("link",{name:"鸟瞰地图",exact:true}).evaluate(link=>{const b=link.getBoundingClientRect();return {url:location.href,href:link.href,text:link.textContent,color:getComputedStyle(link).color,overflow:document.documentElement.scrollWidth>innerWidth,in_viewport:b.left>=0&&b.right<=innerWidth&&b.top>=0&&b.bottom<=innerHeight}}); if(state.overflow||!state.in_viewport)throw Error(JSON.stringify(state)); await page.screenshot({path:"/Users/ffq/Documents/aicoding项目/gis校园地图/"+path}); captures.push({path,viewport,criterion:"Satellite return-to-atlas link visible; tile quality not audited",...state}); } await page.getByRole("link",{name:"鸟瞰地图",exact:true}).click();await page.waitForFunction(()=>document.querySelector(".atlas-map")?.tabIndex===0);return {status:"passed",captures,mobile_return_to_atlas:true}; })(page);
